phase: Vertical slice playable end to end
headline: The whole golden path now runs: 18 of 18 beats clean at 60fps, from arrival in Lumen Vale through all three psychology quests, Whisper Woods, five Echo Shrine rooms and the boss chamber, with the continuity probe confirming a fresh save starts correctly and nothing downstream is reachable early.

findings.text: Cutscenes leaked across map loads: a scene still running when the player left kept narrating over the next place — re-emitting the town's location banner inside the shrine, and able to walk the player and fire insight cards over the wrong map. Scenes now abort on a map-generation change.

Enemy.destroy() left the bramble's telegraph timer armed; the callback then hit a destroyed sprite and the exception killed the render loop permanently. It fired on every player death and every map change.

Vite HMR was full-reloading the page mid-capture whenever another agent saved a file, resetting the game to a fresh save — so screenshots showed the wrong place and playtests reported failures that did not exist. Harnesses now pin the build they boot.
InputManager.inject() wrote into the set cleared at the top of each frame, so every action injected by the QA harness was silently dropped. Injections now queue for the next frame.
CueFollower refused to move when its direct line was blocked, wedging a puzzle creature permanently against any pillar.
shrine_boss hangs the renderer on load — never produces a frame, 30s timeout. Blocks the whole-game playthrough harness.

A dead zone in the upper-middle grass band measures the lowest structural energy in the frame; that is where the square wants to be. Plus uniform-width paths, a path that dissolves into grass, a store with no door, and ~12 identical trees at the same orientation.
Doors are narrower than the characters who must walk through them.

comparisons.title: Town Square vs Stardew Valley world density
comparisons.verdict: Round 2: clearly behind, but the critic's own summary is that the gap is one ground-plane-and-lighting pass wide, not an art-quality pass. Buildings-integrated-vs-dropped-on now scores for us, and it named our lit windows, roof variety and prop sophistication as ahead of the reference.

comparisons.title: Festival Plaza vs Stardew Night Market
comparisons.verdict: The event transformation reads: string lights, bunting, a lit ceremonial carpet, stalls and a gathered crowd. Trial lanterns still need mounts.
